*[Bug 18708] Custom class partialMatchWarning for partial matching*
<https://bugs.r-project.org/show_bug.cgi?id=18708>

--- Comment #6 from Kurt Hornik (<mailto:Kurt.Hornik@wu.ac.at|Kurt.Hornik@wu.ac.at>) ---
I just committed code to also signal partial match dollar warnings with
partialMatchWarning class, so now

options(warnPartialMatchDollar = TRUE)
x <- list(AAA = 123)
w <- tryCatch(x$A, warning = identity)
dput(w)

gives

structure(list(message = "partial match of 'A' to 'AAA'", call = x$A, 
    argument = A, formal = AAA), class = c("partialMatchWarning", 
"warning", "condition"))

Hopefully good enough to close the PR now?

*[Bug 18810] Improve error for readRDS by including filename*
<https://bugs.r-project.org/show_bug.cgi?id=18810>

Kurt Hornik (<mailto:Kurt.Hornik@wu.ac.at|Kurt.Hornik@wu.ac.at>) changed:

           What    |Removed                     |Added
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                 CC|                            |Kurt.Hornik@wu.ac.at

--- Comment #1 from Kurt Hornik (<mailto:Kurt.Hornik@wu.ac.at|Kurt.Hornik@wu.ac.at>) ---
I just committed code which add the filename at C level, so now the example
gives
something like

Error in readRDS(f) : 
  error reading from connection
'/home/Hornik/tmp/R-d-gcc-16/library/MASS/Meta/links.rds'

There are only a few places where we signal errors when reading from
connections, and it would be nice to signal these as classed errors, using
class connectionReadError, which could perhaps the R-level connection object
instead of just its description (as used now).

Patches welcome, maybe a nice R Dev Day task.

text:
*[Bug 18708] Custom class partialMatchWarning for partial matching*
<https://bugs.r-project.org/show_bug.cgi?id=18708>

--- Comment #7 from Suharto Anggono (<mailto:suharto_anggono@yahoo.com|suharto_anggono@yahoo.com>) ---
(In reply to Kurt Hornik from comment #6)
Maybe 'input' and 'target' are better as component names. But I think
'argument' and 'formal' are still OK.

I think the components don't have to be symbols. But CHARSXP shouldn't be
returned. So, maybe symbols are OK.

install(translateChar(input))
could be
installTrChar(input)
.

If not,

    SEXP cond =
        R_makeWarningCondition(call, "partialMatchWarning", NULL, 2,
                               _("partial argument match of '%s' to '%s'"),
                               CHAR(PRINTNAME(argument)),//EncodeChar??
                               CHAR(PRINTNAME(formal)));//EncodeChar??

can be replaced with

    SEXP cond =
        R_makeWarningCondition(call, "partialMatchWarning", NULL, 2,
                               _("partial argument match of '%s' to '%s'"),
                               TYPEOF(argument) == SYMSXP ? 
                               CHAR(PRINTNAME(argument))//EncodeChar??
                               : translateChar(argument),
                               TYPEOF(formal) == SYMSXP ?
                               CHAR(PRINTNAME(formal))//EncodeChar??
                               : translateChar(formal));

,

    R_setConditionField(cond, 2, "argument", argument);
    R_setConditionField(cond, 3, "formal", formal);

can be replaced with

    R_setConditionField(cond, 2, "argument",
                        TYPEOF(argument) == SYMSXP ? argument :
ScalarString(argument));
    R_setConditionField(cond, 3, "formal",
                        TYPEOF(formal) == SYMSXP : formal :
ScalarString(formal));

and

                SEXP cond =
                    R_makePartialMatchWarningCondition(call,
                                                      
install(translateChar(input)), 
                                                       install(st));

can be replaced with

                SEXP cond =
                    R_makePartialMatchWarningCondition(call,
                                                       input, 
                                                       target);

.
